incidents.fingerprint: Vulkan backend unavailable; vanilla collision fallback active: NoClassDefFoundError: org/lwjgl/system/FunctionProvider
incidents.environment: Dedicated Forge 47.4.23 server; isolated collision backend LWJGL 3.3.1 plus merged renderer lwjgl-vulkan 3.3.3 Jar-in-Jar
incidents.root_cause: VkRuntime used an ordinary parent-first URLClassLoader. The parent Forge layer exposed the merged renderer's lwjgl-vulkan 3.3.3, so backend org.lwjgl.vulkan classes were captured from the parent while their LWJGL core dependency was only available through the child runtime on dedicated server.
failed_routes: Ordinary parent-first URLClassLoader for every LWJGL namespace
Treating the renderer and collision Vulkan bindings as one classloader ownership domain
recovery: Load only org.lwjgl.vulkan.* child-first so the collision backend gets its coherent isolated 3.3.1 Vulkan binding.
Keep LWJGL core parent-first with normal URLClassLoader fallback, allowing clients to reuse launcher core while dedicated servers can use embedded 3.3.1 core/native JARs.
